note_on_shipped_setting: ADRN-2B ships context_stickiness=0.25 with 4 real contexts. At 4 contexts 0.25 == 1/4 exactly, so the transition matrix is UNIFORM and a forward filter multiplies by a constant every step: no history survives and evidence accumulation is arithmetically impossible at that setting.
